# IPQS · 1ms.dog

> Free IP quality check. Asks up to 19 IP intelligence sources (Cloudflare, ip-api.com, proxycheck.io, IPQuery, ipapi.is, IP2Location, IPinfo, ipwho.is, IP.SB, iplocation.net, GeoJS, RDAP (RIR), ip.guide, Shodan InternetDB, Tor Project, IPQualityScore, AbuseIPDB, Scamalytics, ipdata) and
> 8 DNS blocklists about an address, then gives a 0–100 score (A–F), whether it is residential or data
> center, native or broadcast (registered country vs. location), VPN/proxy/Tor flags, and what that means for
> streaming, AI services, CAPTCHAs, sign-ups and sending mail. Each source's answer is shown with a link to check it.

- Page: https://ipqs.1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Any address: https://ipqs.1ms.dog/?ip=8.8.8.8
- API (NDJSON stream, one line per source, then the score): https://ipqs.1ms.dog/api/check?ip=8.8.8.8
- Source code: https://github.com/yt1988/ipqs

## Other 1ms.dog tools
- 1ms.dog: https://1ms.dog/ (Your exit IPs and latency to 40 services)
- EgressLens: https://egress.1ms.dog/ (Which IP each site sees: split routing, proxies, WebRTC and IPv6 leaks)
- Me2Cloud: https://m2c.1ms.dog/ (Latency to 360+ cloud regions)
- VPS2Cloud: https://v2c.1ms.dog/ (Latency from your server to the clouds)
- Lightsail Cost Saver: https://ls.1ms.dog/ (AWS Lightsail transfer calculator)
